title: Make the Psionic fixture state honest: a check that every fixture path resolves (top action #22)
body:
From the 2026-10-10 codebase-health audit (top action #22: PS1-02, PS2-01, PS3-02, PS4-02, X-DEAD-02, PS1-19).

`crates/psionic` was imported as the dependency closure of `psionic-openai-server`, but most fixture files its crates read were never imported. Tests that load a missing fixture fail by construction, which hides real failures and blocks adding Psionic to any gate. The README also overstated the imported fixture set.

## What this lands

- `scripts/dev/check-psionic-fixtures.py` scans every `*_FIXTURE_PATH` constant under `crates/psionic/crates`, resolves each relative to `crates/psionic/`, and reports the ones that do not exist.
- `scripts/dev/psionic-missing-fixtures.txt` records the current missing set (204 of 275 constants). The check fails when a **new** missing path appears, and reports when an allowlisted one starts resolving so it can be removed — the list may only shrink.
- A new gate phase `psionic-fixtures` runs the check (0.2 s, no compile), added to the default `verify-rust.sh` phase set.
- `scripts/tests/test_gate_psionic_fixtures.py` covers the ratchet both ways.
- The psionic README's stale "only the 23 files" claim is corrected.

## Remaining (tracked separately)

- Import or regenerate the fixtures the live path needs, and delete the constants and tests for modules that were not imported. The allowlist is the work list.
- Add `cargo test`/`clippy` for the psionic crates to a lane (PS4-01, PS2-07, PS3-04).
